name: Ayashii Kyouso to Fubin'na Joshu-kun ~ 30-Nichi-Go ni Shinu Kyouso ~
original_name: 怪しい教祖と不憫な助手くん ～30日後に死ぬ教祖～
source:
The protagonist, an assistant to a certain cult leader, is told by a fortune teller one day that his master is destined to die in 30 days. 

Despite his mean streak, the leader was the only one to ever help the protagonist. Thus, determined to save his master, he sets out to unravel the mystery behind this prophecy...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13978]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
主人公是某邪教头目的助手，有一天，算命先生告诉他，他的主人注定会在三十天内死去。

尽管领导者性格恶劣，但他是唯一帮助主角的人。于是，他决心拯救自己的主人，开始揭开这个预言背后的谜团……

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13978]Novelgame[/url]]
